//: Required settings are deliberately ABSENT from this file rather than present and blank.
An empty string is a value as far as configuration is concerned, so a blank key here
silently overrides every lower-precedence source. That is not hypothetical: blank keys
here are what stopped .env from configuring a local run, and the symptom was the app
reporting credentials as missing while they sat in a file it had just read.
The settings this application uses, and where they go:
App:PublicBaseUrl                      required, absolute, no trailing slash
docker compose  ->  .env at the repository root
dotnet run      ->  .env, or dotnet user-secrets, or environment variables
Never put real credentials in this file: it is committed. Startup fails with an
explanatory message when a required setting is missing.
